camel_example: aliyun vod DescribeVodDomainTrafficData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --EndTime '2019-01-20T14:59:58Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn shanghai --StartTime '2019-01-20T13:59:58Z' --Interval 300
description_en: Invokes this operation to query the traffic data of an accelerated domain name. Compared with the DescribeVodDomainRealTimeTrafficData operation, this operation supports a longer historical data query range (up to 366 days) but provides a larger data time granularity (minimum of 5 minutes) and higher data latency
description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名的流量数据，相比DescribeVodDomainRealTimeTrafficData接口，本接口支持可查询的历史数据时间范围更长（最长可查询最近366天的数据），但其数据时间粒度更大（最小为5分钟），数据延迟更高
kebab_example: aliyun vod describe-vod-domain-traffic-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2019-01-20T13:59:58Z --end-time 2019-01-20T14:59:58Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVodDomainTrafficData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name to query.

If you do not specify this parameter, the pooled data of all accelerated domain names is returned by default.
Batch queries are supported. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 500 domain names at a time.
You can log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com), and choose Configuration Management > CDN Configuration > Domain Names in the left-side navigation pane to view the accelerated domain names that you have added to ApsaraVideo VOD. You can also invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455030.html operation to query the list of accelerated domain names
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的加速域名。

不传入该参数，则默认返回所有加速域名的合并数据。
支持批量查询，多个域名之间用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持500个域名查询。
您可以登录视频点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，从左侧导航选择配置管理 > 分发加速配置 > 域名管理，查看您已接入到视频点播的加速域名，或者调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455030.html接口查询加速域名列表
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. 

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点。 

日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the data entries. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 300, 3600, and 86400. If you do not specify this parameter or specify an unsupported value, the default value is used. The supported time granularity varies based on the time span specified by `StartTime` and `EndTime`:

Less than 3 days (exclusive): 300 (default), 3600, and 86400.
3 to 31 days (exclusive): 3600 (default) and 86400.
31 days or more: 86400 (default)
parameters.help_zh:
设置查询数据的时间粒度。单位：秒。取值：300、3600和86400。不传和传的值不支持时，使用默认值。根据您指定的`StartTime`和`EndTime`的时间跨度，支持设置的时间粒度如下：

3天以内（不包含3天整）支持：300（默认）、3600、86400。
3-31天（不包含31天整）支持：3600（默认）和86400。
31天以上支持：86400（默认）
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The name of the Internet service provider (ISP) in English. If you do not specify this parameter, data of all ISPs is queried by default
parameters.help_zh: 运营商英文名。不传入该参数，默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en: The name of the region in English. If you do not specify this parameter, data of all regions is queried by default. Only the Shanghai region is supported
parameters.help_zh: 地域英文名。不传入该参数，默认查询所有地域。目前仅支持上海地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between the data entries, which is the time granularity of the data. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，即数据的时间粒度。单位：秒

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range for the returned data

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range for the returned data
